# Yog Jivan — Authentic Indian Yoga, Live

Website: https://yogjivan.com
Business: Yog Jivan Sanctuary
Founder & Lead Yoga Teacher: Master Anil Choudhary (12+ years teaching authentic Indian yoga)
Community: 10,000+ students guided, 20+ countries served

## In one paragraph

Yog Jivan is an authentic Indian yoga school founded by Master Anil Choudhary, Founder & Lead Yoga Teacher. It operates two studios in the Hai Duong urban area of Hai Phong, Vietnam; live small-group online classes worldwide (maximum 8 students, 60 minutes, camera on for real-time correction); and personalized private online yoga sessions (solo 1-on-1, couples for 2 adults, and family for 3–4 household members) with a matched teacher from the Yog Jivan team. In Northern Vietnam, Yog Jivan provides on-site corporate chair and mat yoga for workplaces and child-friendly yoga modules for schools. Teaching is available in English, Vietnamese, and Hindi, subject to teacher availability.

## Locations

Note on geography: the former Hai Duong province merged into Hai Phong on 1 July 2025. The current official city is Hai Phong; "Hai Duong" remains the familiar local name for the urban area where both studios are located.

## Live online classes (small-group)

- Led personally by Master Anil Choudhary, Founder & Lead Yoga Teacher
- Duration: 60 minutes
- Maximum live group size: 8 students
- Camera on required for real-time verbal alignment correction
- Languages: English, Vietnamese, Hindi
- Catch-up recording available to active members for 48 hours
- Short 15-minute onboarding and practice-safety conversation before first class

## Privacy and child protection

Yog Jivan strictly safeguards family and student privacy. For school yoga and parent-child sessions, no child names, dates of birth, photos, or medical records are collected or stored. In-person school sessions are conducted on school grounds under school supervision.

## Refunds

Memberships and session packages are generally non-refundable once activated or after the first session has commenced. Exceptions apply for duplicate charges, cancellation or non-delivery by Yog Jivan, material service failures, and statutory consumer protections under applicable law. Inquiries: hello@yogjivan.com.

## Health note

Yog Jivan offers authentic yoga and wellness instruction, not medical diagnosis, treatment, or advice. Consult a healthcare provider before beginning if pregnant, recovering from injury or surgery, or managing a medical condition.
